name: next
description: A NEXT band above the prompt with 2 or 3 short prompts you would likely send next, from one Haiku (or Sonnet) call over the last reply and the task list: after each long answer, or on /next; 1 to 3 put one in the prompt box (nothing is sent), 0 dismisses; hidden while a turn runs, cleared when you send a prompt.

auto.title: Suggest after every long answer
auto.description: on: after each main-loop answer over 300 characters, with no subagent still running, one model call suggests the next prompts (default); off: only when you run /next.

model.title: Suggestion model
model.description: haiku: fast and cheap (default); sonnet: slower, reads long replies better. Used by /next and the automatic suggestions.
